Well, yeah, I guess I do have trouble sticking to one thing, but like I was just saying, it's because I have so much to get out. When I start trying to explain my plans, or all the stuff that's been happening—you know, with the voices and how they're tracking me—the words just pour out of me. It happens so fast.
